To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
farmers prefer high yielding varieties with drought tolerance and long duration.
the farmers are willing to pay more for yield, color and long duration ragi variety.
the farmers in Tumkur and Hassan districts are willing to pay more for yield and colour of new varieties of ragi.
In summary, our research is concerned with
identifying the factors influencing producer and consumer preferences for finger millet and the willingness to pay by farmers for new varieties.
the relative importance of different traits of finger millet varieties and how these traits influence the producer and consumer willingness to pay for a new variety.
the identification of the factors that affect farmers’ and consumers’ preferences for ragi and their willingness to pay (or accept) for these traits.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

there is a need for developing new varieties of ragi with higher yield, drought tolerant and long duration, which would help to increase the area under ragi cultivation and to increase the productivity.
, there are several traits which influence the producer and consumer preferences.
, the study has provided the scientific basis for the development of new varieties that can meet the needs of the producers and consumers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, there is a potential to increase the area under ragi cultivation in the state by developing new improved varieties.
the study has provided an insight on producer and consumer preference for new ragi varieties.
there is a scope to increase the production of ragi and the research scientists should work on developing varieties that would suit the farmers as well as consumers.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the farmers and consumers have different priorities in their preferences.
the yield enhancing technologies are not the only factor that farmers consider in their decision making.
the traits that the producers seek in ragi are different from those that the consumers seek, which is a very important information for the breeders to consider.
